5949f8c8dd13eac437f545b420d27f200974df27.summary: Barracuda Networks reports that the North Korean APT group Kimsuky exploits weak or misconfigured DMARC email policies to run spear-phishing campaigns that spoof legitimate domains. The targets described are experts in think tanks, media and academia, and the report says the FBI and NSA issued a joint advisory on these campaigns. In some cases the attackers reportedly access legitimate email systems. The report advises setting DMARC to quarantine or reject rather than monitor only, and recommends training staff.
